relations.text: H&R Blockが10-Kで、口座を開く銀行パートナーとして挙げる。還付前払い(EA)の参加権も買い取る
relations.text_en: H&R Block names it as its bank partner for accounts and buys participation interests in its refund advances

source.label: H&R Block 10-K(2026年6月期)
source.quote: Revenues are recognized when the Internal Revenue Service (IRS) filing acknowledgment is received and the bank account is established at our bank partner, Pathward

relations.text: MoneyLionが10-Kで、預金口座とデビットカードを提供するための提携先として挙げる
relations.text_en: MoneyLion's partnership with Pathward lets it offer deposit accounts and debit cards

source.label: MoneyLion 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Our partnership with Pathward allows us to provide deposit accounts and debit cards while complying with various federal, state and other laws.

relations.text: Gen Digitalが10-Kで、金融商品の銀行パートナーとして挙げる
relations.text_en: Gen Digital names Pathward as the bank partner behind its financial products

source.label: Gen Digital 10-K(2025年3月期)
source.quote: We must comply with various federal and state consumer protection regimes, both as a result of the financial products and services we provide directly or facilitate and as a service provider to our bank partner, Pathward.

relations.text: The Bancorpが10-Kで、プリペイド・デビットのBaaS銀行の競合として名指し
relations.text_en: The Bancorp names it a banking-as-a-service competitor in prepaid and debit cards

source.label: The Bancorp 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: For prepaid and debit card accounts, our largest source of funding and fee income, competitors include banking as a service banks, such as Pathward Financial, Coastal Community, and others.
